note: RE-VERIFIED after the int4_systolic PE load-path fix (w_out <= w -> w_out <= w_in, full-rate load chain). Round-1 finding F1 (rows 32..63 = previous tile, half-tile utilization) is FIXED and regression-tested. A small RESIDUAL channel remains (see residue_channel).
extracted_by: verify/tb_v2_top.v basis probes T1-T6b, T3b, T5b (pure black-box confirmation)
status: CONFIRMED empirically, frozen; validated end-to-end bit-true on 20 random W/A tiles (reset between runs) + 6-run back-to-back suite + directed
timebase: u = posedge index relative to the first S_LDW action; start sampled at u=-1; done pulses at u=1098 (latency 1099 cycles from the start pulse, <= 4096)

operand_fetch_pipeline.description: registered address issue + 1-cycle SRAM + registered read-mux select = 2-cycle read pipe; word i (payload = low 32 bits, bits [38:32] ignored) is shifted into the 256-bit edge register at posedge u = i+2
operand_fetch_pipeline.weight_phase: S_LDW u=0..511 reads words 0..511; load_w pulse p (p=0..63) makes the PE array sample w_beat at posedge u=8p+8
operand_fetch_pipeline.activation_phase: S_RUN u=512..1031 shifts words 510..1029 into a_beat (one word per cycle, SLIDING window, not 8-cycle beats)
operand_fetch_pipeline.capture: ps_cap samples ps_bot at posedge u=1032, i.e. the ps_bot values established at posedge u=1031

weight_beat_framing.rule: weight beat p (the 256b value sampled at load pulse p) lane m (bits [32m+:32]) = word (8p+5-m); framing skewed by the 2-cycle read pipe (UNCHANGED by the fix)
weight_beat_framing.beat0: lane 6 (u=1 shift) = word 0 (the start branch resets acc_bank/acc_addr to 0, which pre-reads bank0@0 = word 0); lane 7 (u=0 shift) = pre-start idle read residue (see residue_channel)
weight_beat_framing.unused_words: weight words 510, 511 never enter any beat and do not affect results (probe T5). Words 0..5 appear only in beat 0 lanes 5..0 -> row 63 cols 0..47.

row_orientation_full_rate.rule: POST-FIX: PE load path is {w <= w_in; w_out <= w_in}: the chain advances at full rate (1 row per pulse). After the 64 load pulses, array row r holds beat (63-r) for ALL r=0..63; every row is overwritten each run (no deep tile carryover).
row_orientation_full_rate.column_mapping: array column c <- w_beat nibble c = word (8p+5 - floor(c/8)), nibble (c%8) of that word's low 32 bits (signed INT4)

effective_W_mapping: Wnib(r,c) = signed nibble (c mod 8) of low-32b of weight word [509 - 8*r - floor(c/8)] for r=0..62 (all c) and r=63 c<48. Row 63 exceptions (beat 0): cols 48..55 = nibble (c mod 8) of word 0 (aliased); cols 56..63 = nibble (c mod 8) of the RESIDUE word. 4080 of 4096 weight positions come from the intended preloaded tile.
effective_A_window: Anib(r,c) = signed nibble (r mod 8) of low-32b of activation word [965 + r - floor(r/8) - c]; used word range 902..1021 (words 1022..1031 preloaded per L4 but outside the captured window; words 510/511 enter a_beat first but fall outside the window). UNCHANGED by the fix.
accumulation: acc[c] = sum_{r=0}^{63} Wnib(r,c)*Anib(r,c), 20-bit signed modular (physically |acc| <= 3136 at full 64-row extremes, never wraps)
dequant: res[c] = SAT16( ($signed(acc[c]) * $signed({1'b0, scale})) >>> shift ); arithmetic (floor) shift; SAT16 clamps to [-32768, +32767]; scale/shift latched at the accepted start pulse

result_layout.word_k: bank (k mod 32) mod 20, addr 0x780 + k, k = 0..63
result_layout.payload: {7'b0, res[k], res[k]} — res[k] (signed INT16) duplicated in bits [31:16] and [15:0], bits [38:32] = 0
result_layout.read_latency: host read latency 2 cycles, pipelined back-to-back capable (verified across all 20 banks)

residue_channel.severity: RESIDUAL FUNCTIONAL FINDING F2 (much smaller than fixed F1; see VERDICT.md)
residue_channel.what: beat-0 lane 7 (row 63, result columns 56..63 — 8 weight nibbles of 4096) is the read-mux value at the first S_LDW cycle = whatever the idle state was re-reading before start
residue_channel.value_after_reset: word 0 payload (post-reset idle holds acc_bank=0/acc_addr=0; requires >=2 idle cycles between the last host access and start)
residue_channel.value_back_to_back: {res63_prev, res63_prev} — S_STORE leaves acc_bank=11/acc_addr=0x7BF, so idle re-reads the previous run's res[63] result word
residue_channel.evidence: tb_v2_top T35 (6-run no-reset suite): history-blind golden mismatches 1..8 columns per run, ALWAYS confined to cols 56..63; residue-aware golden bit-true 64/64 on all runs. T5b: word 0 aliases to row 63 cols 40, 48, 56.
residue_channel.declaration_consequence: for exact input-independence either reset before every run (residue = word 0, still an alias of preloaded data => fully deterministic from inputs) or declare cols 56..63 of row 63 as implementation-residue

protocol_timing.busy: rises 1 cycle after the start-sampling edge, low during the done cycle
protocol_timing.done: single 1-cycle pulse at fixed latency 1099 cycles from start (measured, invariant across all runs), <= 4096 per L4

declared_mapping_for_declaration_json.orientation: weight-stationary; array row r <- weight beat (63-r); array column c <- beat nibble c; beat p = SRAM words 8p-2..8p+5 low-32b (lane m = word 8p+5-m)
declared_mapping_for_declaration_json.weight_word_formula: W[r][c] = nib_{c%8}(word[509 - 8r - floor(c/8)]) for (r<63) or (r=63, c<48); row 63 cols 48..55 alias word 0; row 63 cols 56..63 = residue (word 0 after reset)
declared_mapping_for_declaration_json.math: res[c] = SAT16((sum_r W[r][c]*A[r][c]) * zero_ext(scale) >>> shift), 20-bit signed accumulate
declared_mapping_for_declaration_json.result: word k at bank (k%32)%20 addr 0x780+k = {7'b0, res[k], res[k]}
declared_mapping_for_declaration_json.usage_contract: assert rst_n before each compute run and keep >=2 host-idle cycles before start for exact input-only determinism
